hero.title: Bless Fourchette
hero.subtitle: Nourish and serve according to our values and beliefs
hero.description: We proudly offer Canado-Haitian cuisine, featuring two distinct culinary styles: flavorful, traditional Haitian dishes and comforting Canadian classics. All meals are 100% vegan, fresh, and thoughtfully prepared to highlight the richness of each cuisine.

about.missionSubtitle: A Mission Rooted in Faith and Community
about.moreThanMealService: More Than Just a Meal Service
about.mealServiceDescription: BLESS FOURCHETTE is more than just a meal service—it's a community founded on faith, generosity, and sharing. We believe that nourishing the body and soul go hand in hand, and that every meal is an opportunity to create connections and serve with love.
about.scriptureQuote: And God said: Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
about.givingBack: Giving Back: The Heart of Our Business
about.givingBackDescription: A portion of every dollar you spend actively supports the fight against sickle cell anemia. We are proud to contribute to medical research, patient support, and awareness programs.
about.foundersVisionDescription: Our passion for holistic health and faith guides every aspect of BLESS FOURCHETTE. Supporting the fight against sickle cell anemia is not just a business mission—it's a calling from the heart, a deep conviction that we can make a difference in others' lives.
about.foundersQuote: Every meal we prepare, every family we serve, every dollar we give back—all of this is part of a greater purpose to nourish our community and heal our world.

howToOrder.title: HOW TO ORDER
howToOrder.subtitle: Simple • Fast • Secure
howToOrder.description: Order fresh, convenient meals in Just a few easy steps: Choose your menu, select your delivery date, and pay securely. All our meals are vegan and free from peanuts and other common allergens.
howToOrder.step1Description: Browse our School Menu (Monday-Thursday) for school meals or Family Menu (Monday-Friday) for family platters. Each option features fresh, nutritious vegan ingredients and offering a BBQ service as well.
howToOrder.orderDeadline: Order deadline: 6:00 PM the day before
howToOrder.step2Description: Choose a convenient delivery date that works for you. We offer flexible delivery options to fit your schedule.
howToOrder.step3Description: Complete your order with our secure payment system. We accept all major credit cards and secure online payments.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.answer1: Orders must be placed by 6:00 PM the day before delivery. For example, to receive meals on Monday, you must order by Sunday at 6:00 PM. This ensures we have enough time to prepare fresh, quality meals for everyone.
faq.question2: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
faq.answer2: Yes, you can modify or cancel your order up to 6:00 PM the day before delivery. After this deadline, we cannot guarantee changes as meal preparation may have already begun. However, if a student will be absent, please notify us by email no later than 7:00 AM on the day of delivery. The order will be canceled and a full refund will be automatically applied to your account and deducted from your next invoice.
faq.question3: What areas do you deliver to?
faq.answer3: We currently deliver to schools and families within our service area. During checkout, you can enter your address to confirm delivery availability. Please note: No delivery fee for school orders, a delivery fee will be applied to family orders only
faq.question4: How do I track my order?
faq.answer4: After placing your order, you'll receive a receipt email with tracking information. We'll send updates when your order is being prepared and when it's out for delivery. You can also contact us directly for real-time updates on your order status.
faq.question5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer5: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and secure online payment methods. All transactions are processed through our secure payment gateway to ensure your financial information is protected.
